challenges_daily_desc: Every day, a new secret 15-cell grid awaits all players. Only one validation attempt — no bonuses, no mistakes allowed. Complete it before midnight and climb the world leaderboard. Keep your daily streak going!
challenges_friends_desc: Create a unique challenge and share it with your friends via a link. Everyone plays the same grid independently. Best time wins!
challenges_onf_desc: A forest-themed Sudoku! Fill a 4 by 4 square grid following the usual adjacency rules AND the Sudoku rule: only one of each element per row and per column. Every grid has a single solution.
challenges_onf_tier_sentier: The Path (end of chapter {{chapter}}): the starting tier. Its {{count}} grids are played in order, from the easiest (8 cells already placed) to the hardest (5). With lumberjack, bear, sheep and wolf, you first learn the row / column rule, then the wolf / sheep rule.
challenges_onf_tier_clairiere: The Clearing (end of chapter {{chapter}}): new residents arrive, the beehive and the stag / doe pair. {{count}} grids, picked at random.
challenges_onf_tier_profonde: The deep forest (end of chapter {{chapter}}): the mushroom, placed in the centre of the grid, joins the game. {{count}} grids, picked at random.
challenges_onf_how: How it works: you always play in the most advanced tier you have opened. When you have solved all of its grids, you go back to the previous tier. If every open tier is finished, keep playing solo to open the next one. Tiers open as you finish chapters in solo mode.
challenges_onf_rewards: Rewards: {{base}} seeds per grid ({{bonus}} more if you solve it in under 2 minutes) and a free tree card for your Herbarium every {{every}} grids.
challenges_plans_all: For everyone: unlimited solo challenges, and the Daily Challenge (one game per day).
challenges_plans_free: Free: every day, {{onf}} Forest Challenge grids, {{tokens}} Duel tokens and {{bonus}} uses of each bonus (rechargeable by video). Everything comes back at midnight.
challenges_plans_premium: Premium (one-time payment): unlimited Forest Challenge, Duel and bonuses. €1 of your purchase goes to Planète Urgence to plant real trees.
challenges_plans_bonus: Using a bonus has a cost: the challenge can no longer earn 3 pinecones (2 at best) and earns 2 fewer seeds per bonus. There are no bonuses in the Daily Challenge or the Forest Challenge.
challenges_plans_videos: Videos are always optional. From the home screen they only help plant real trees with the shared forest (up to {{videos}} per day, free or premium). In a game, a free player whose bonus is used up can also watch a video to recharge it (up to {{bonusVideos}} per bonus per day). When your Forest Challenge quota is reached, a video gives you {{onfGrids}} more challenges (once per day). A premium player does not need it: their bonuses and challenges are unlimited. No video ever gives seeds or tokens.

about_history_body:
In the Forest is originally a logic game designed by Cédric Martinez, published by Djeco under the name Woodanimo in the SoLogic range.

We wanted to adapt it for mobile to enrich the experience, offering new grids, new elements and new rules.

The backbone of the challenges remains the same: place forest elements on a board of hexagonal cells, respecting neighbourhood constraints between them.

Today it is a full game:
about_feature_1: · Solve logic puzzles of increasing difficulty
about_feature_2: · 4 game modes: Solo, Friend challenges, Daily and Planète Urgence
about_feature_5: · Earn seeds and beat time records
about_approach_body:
Pedagogical progression is central: each level introduces a new element with its rules, through an animated briefing before the game.

Sensitive to environmental issues and the disasters facing forests (fires and drought), we wanted this game to also be an awareness tool.

The environment is designed to be welcoming — a forest world that surrounds you with animal animations and feel-good music.

The educational and awareness aspect is expressed in a playful way through the Planète Urgence challenge mode. You will be able to unlock cards related to tree species found in French forests.
about_onf_body:
In partnership with Planète Urgence, we wanted to contribute to field actions by donating a portion of the funds collected through the app.

These funds will be used to replant trees in French forests. The remainder will help promote the game and fund Kromia's future projects.
about_onf_highlight: For each purchase of the game, 1 euro is donated to the Planète Urgence foundation.
about_onf_ads: Money collected through ads viewed in the app will also be partially donated to the foundation.
about_team_body:
Kromia is a game development studio. In the Forest is its first game.

The founder is Cédric Martinez, who continues his creative work with traditional publishers while developing new projects through Kromia.
